title: Stack-aware branch maintenance
description: Manual isolated production-gateway proof through replay/get/cancel RPCs, followed by an upstream Git rebase and exact-lease push. Requires an existing tmux server; creates one owned detached session.

maintenance.intent: Verify stacked and retargeted maintenance tasks use the publication base while preserving default-branch freshness, then rebase the child without dropping upstream commits.

ci_watch.intent: Drive the native CI-fix writer through public CI-watch replay for default and token-less templates, both stacked and retargeted. Preserve retained TASK.md and require the current publication base and lease guard.
